
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /mcp                                       │
  │  MCP Server Connections                     │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Manage MCP (Model Context Protocol) server connections.

  Usage:
    /mcp
    /mcp status
    /mcp list
    /mcp add
    /mcp connect <name>
    /mcp disconnect <name>
    /mcp remove <name>

  Details:
    Connect to external MCP servers to extend RadSim with additional tools.
    MCP is the same protocol used by Claude Desktop, Cursor, and other tools.
    
    Subcommands:
      status     - Show all servers and connection state (default)
      list       - Show all tools from connected servers
      add        - Interactively add a new server
      connect    - Connect to a configured server
      disconnect - Disconnect from a server
      remove     - Remove a server configuration
    
    Config file: ~/.radsim/mcp.json
    Supports: stdio, SSE, and Streamable HTTP transports.
    Install MCP SDK: pip install radsimcli[mcp]

  Examples:
    $ /mcp
    $ /mcp add
    $ /mcp connect filesystem
    $ /mcp list

  Tips:
    Tip: MCP tools appear alongside native tools in /tools output.
    Tip: All MCP tools require confirmation unless auto_confirm is enabled.
    Tip: Set autoConnect: true in config to connect on startup.

  Related: /tools  /config
